## Verification

- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`
- [ ] `uv run pytest`
- [ ] `npm run build:css` if dashboard styles changed
- [ ] `uv build` if package metadata or dependencies changed
- [ ] `docker build -t issuedeck:pr-check .` if Docker, packaging, or deployment files changed

## Release Notes

- [ ] User-facing changes are listed in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Docs are updated when behavior, setup, deployment, or security guidance changes
